description:
SBIR and STTR awards since 1983 from SBA's SBIR.gov records, and who received them:
    totals, awards by year (Phase I / II), by agency, the companies with the most, and the
    latest awards (company, title, agency, phase, amount, year). Filters: agency (as SBIR.gov
    names it, e.g. "Department of Defense"), phase ("Phase I" or "Phase II"), program ("SBIR" or
    "STTR"), state (the winner's), q (words in the award title), company_uei, since (first award
    year). open_topics: also the SBIR/STTR solicitations open now (SAM.gov and Grants.gov).
    SBIR.gov counts awards by award year; USAspending (run_plan) counts money by fiscal year, so
    the two differ.

agency.description: The awarding agency as SBIR.gov names it, e.g. "Department of Defense", "National Science Foundation".
agency.title: Agency

open_topics.description: Also list the SBIR/STTR solicitations open now (SAM.gov and Grants.gov).
open_topics.title: Open Topics

phase.description: The award phase: Phase I or Phase II.
phase.title: Phase

q.description: Words in the award title, e.g. "hypersonic" or "battery".
q.title: Q

since.description: First award year to count, e.g. 2020.
since.title: Since

state.description: The winner's two-letter state code, e.g. "VA".
state.title: State

name: sbir_awards
title: Search SBIR and STTR awards
